name: @muralink/ai
description: AI provider adapter — a stack-agnostic AiProvider interface plus an offline Mock, a local Ollama adapter and online adapters (Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini, plain fetch, no SDKs). Every LLM call goes through this seam so the concrete provider is swappable; API keys live server-side only. Local-first: with nothing configured the Mock keeps the chat flow working offline.
